title: chore(functional-tests): mock JS client data
body:
This change implements a fake algoliaserch-client with pre-recorded data. I wished we could have something close to Jest snapshots so that we could easily record and update the data. That's not the case but maybe it could an iteration over that.

The motivation is to be able to make sure that the behaviour of our test never change because of:
 - network
 - index being updated

It should fix the dataset in order to make argos give us consistent tests.

PS: I kept commented the code that let you record the data
